answer: An admission auction stops bulk fake identities: only 100 work slots open each epoch, and agents bid a deposit to claim one, losers refunded, winners locked for 20 epochs. A forger wanting 1,000 timber-trading slots must outbid honest traders 1,000 times, paying twice 30-day expected earnings per slot, so total cost spirals past any profit from an echo of fake ivory orders. One honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and earns undiluted rewards.
